name: Fast Searching Algorithm for Dye Advection
aliases: Breadth First Search for dye path
Fast Searching Algorithm for Dye Advection — Direct Flow-Back Search
Flow-back Neighbor Search for Dye Advection
definition: An algorithm to rapidly locate cells affected by a new dye injection without searching the entire field, based on the relation that only cells whose negative streamlines pass through the dyed region within the convolution length $L$ receive color contributions.
summary: Fast Searching Algorithm for Dye Advection uses Breadth First Search on a sparse graph of direct flow-back neighbors to efficiently identify affected grid cells without scanning the entire volume.
